messages:
vik: quick ping  opened a tiny PR to simplify the Ruby sampleapp onboarding flow. goal: make token refresh example copy-pasteable for community users. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sdk/pull/1502

sara: nice. what's the main change? shorter CLI, less setup?

vik: removed the manual curl calls and added a single `bin/run_sample` script that sets a short-lived token, runs the sample, and demonstrates refresh logic. also added a short cookbook section in README.

felix: can you paste the script? want to review for secrets hygiene before merging.

vik: script is tiny: ```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=${REDWOOD_API_KEY:-""}
ruby examples/stream_demo.rb --auto-refresh
```

sara: small nit: avoid exporting empty strings; prefer to error if REDWOOD_API_KEY is missing so users don't accidentally run with a blank token. add a helpful error message and a note about using `export REDWOOD_API_KEY"<test-token>"` or `direnv`.

vik: good point. I'll add a check and a friendly message with a link to the dev keys doc.

ci-bot: lint job failed for PR 1502: RuboCop offense in examples/stream_demo.rb (Style/GuardClause). Logs: https://ci.internal/builds/10211

felix: rubocop is easy to fix. Also ensure the example uses the `Redwood::Auth::Refreshable` helper, not custom retry logic. We want parity across sampleapps.

vik: updated to use Refreshable helper and fixed rubocop. also added a one-liner in README under "Quickstart (Windows/Linux/Mac)" and a note about `bundle exec bin/run_sample` to avoid bundler confusion.

sara: for community contributors on older rubies, can we add a short section "If you see Bundler/Binstub issues" that points to `gem install bundler -v X && bundle _X_ install`? reduces onboarding friction.

vik: will add that. also added a tiny integration test that runs `bin/run_sample` in CI but gated behind `CI_RUN_SAMPLES=true` to avoid slowing default pipelines.

ci-bot: integration-gated job queued (CI_RUN_SAMPLES=true).

felix: looks good to me. one more ask: add `--help` output for the script so contributors can discover the flag for `--auto-refresh` vs `--manual`. small UX win.

vik: added `--help` and a brief README snippet showing both modes. pinging for review again.

ci-bot: vk pushed commit 2a8f3c. pipeline re-run; lint and gated integration job succeeded. build: https://ci.internal/builds/10214

sara: awesome. thanks for making the sampleapp easier to run. this will cut down on community support noise.

vik: thanks all. merging after @felix approves. will follow up with a short community post linking the new quickstart + troubleshooting tips.
